summary: F1 fixed: _record_local_only (migrate.py) now also indexes the secret-pattern local-only files of rows with action skipped-equal (only when the file exists in the workspace project folder), so a repeat of apply --local-only-secrets after a stop behind the rename writes the local-only.json rows and rebuilds the exclude block; _warnings counts secret-pattern files of skipped-equal units too, so the repeat's report carries PS_SECRET_LOCAL_ONLY. Big size files are not touched in that path (next sync finds them). New regression test in LocalOnlySecretsTests simulates the stop (real bridge apply, marker reset to legacy, OSError), repeats apply with the flag and checks the index, the exclude block, the report warning, doctor --publish-safety (with and without --all) exit 0 with no block, and sync --commit not tracking the files. Ran tests.test_migrate + tests.test_localonly (86 OK) in packages/workspace. CHANGELOG of the workspace module got one sentence.
